units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 34a:11">B. Kam. 34ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כשעת ה׳ בדין</he> according to the condition of the animal at the time of appearance in court.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 32b:5">Bekh. 32ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>בעי ה׳ והערכה</he> must be placed (before the priest) and appraised (<cite ref="Leviticus 27:11">Lev. XXVII, 11</cite>).
<cite ref="Leviticus 27:11">Ib.</cite> <he>בכלל ה׳ וכ׳</he> subject to the law requiring placing &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 41b:10">Yoma 41ᵇ</cite> <he>אה׳ קאי</he> does it refer to the placing of the sacrifice (to <he>והעמידו</he>, Mish.
<cite ref="Yoma 41b:10">ib.</cite>)?—Y. Maas. III, 54ᶜ top <he>ה׳ והערכה</he> (interchanging with <cite ref="P00862"><he>עמדה</he></cite>).
